verses.1: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.2: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.3: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, + 16:3 Or a portion of meat and a raisin cake.
verses.4: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.5: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah was second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals
verses.6:
and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
 David’s Psalm of Thanksgiving
 ( Psalm 105:1–15|PSA 105:1-15 )
verses.7: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:
verses.8:
“Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name;
 make known His deeds among the nations.
verses.9:
Sing to Him, sing praises to Him;
 tell of all His wonders.
verses.10:
Glory in His holy name;
 let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.11:
Seek out the LORD and His strength;
 seek His face always.
verses.12:
Remember the wonders He has done,
 His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
verses.13:
O offspring of His servant Israel,
 O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.14:
He is the LORD our God;
 His judgments carry throughout the earth.
verses.15:
Remember + 16:15 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts He remembers ; see Psalm 105:8|PSA 105:8 . His covenant forever,
 the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
verses.16:
the covenant He made with Abraham,
 and the oath He swore to Isaac.
verses.17:
He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree,
 to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
verses.18:
‘I will give you the land of Canaan
 as the portion of your inheritance.’
verses.19:
When they were few in number,
 few indeed, and strangers in the land,
verses.20:
they wandered from nation to nation,
 from one kingdom to another.
verses.21:
He let no man oppress them;
 He rebuked kings on their behalf:
verses.22:
‘Do not touch My anointed ones!
 Do no harm to My prophets!’
 Sing to the LORD, All the Earth
 ( Psalm 96:1–13|PSA 96:1-13 )
verses.23:
Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
 Proclaim His salvation day after day.
verses.24:
Declare His glory among the nations,
 His wonders among all peoples.
verses.25:
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised;
 He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.26:
For all the gods of the nations are idols,
 but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
verses.27:
Splendor and majesty are before Him;
 strength and joy fill His dwelling.
verses.28:
Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations,
 ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.31:
Let the heavens be glad,
 and the earth rejoice.
 Let them say among the nations,
 ‘The LORD reigns!’
verses.33:
Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD,
 for He is coming to judge the earth.
verses.34:
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
 His loving devotion + 16:34 Forms of the Hebrew chesed are translated here and in most cases throughout the Scriptures as loving devotion ; the range of meaning includes love , goodness , kindness , faithfulness , and mercy , as well as loyalty to a covenant . endures forever.
verses.35:
Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation;
 gather and deliver us from the nations,
 that we may give thanks to Your holy name,
 that we may glory in Your praise.’
verses.36:
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel,
 from everlasting to everlasting.”
 Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!”
 Worship before the Ark
verses.37: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
verses.38: along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives. Obed-edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were to be gatekeepers.
verses.39: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
verses.40: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
verses.41: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
verses.42: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God. + 16:42 Or instruments for the sacred music And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
verses.43: Then all the people departed for their homes, and David returned home to bless his household.
